title.zh: Max AI 导师简短对话、双语字幕与即时重连
title.en: Max AI tutor concise conversation, bilingual captions and immediate reconnect

purpose.zh: 让 AI 导师用当前学习语言简短开场，提供慢速、站点语言译文和简短回答开关，移除学生实时字幕的旧转写模型，并修复结束语音后立即重连的限流误判。
purpose.en: Introduce the tutor briefly in the learning language, offer pace, support-language and short-answer controls, remove the legacy learner-caption transcription model, and fix the false rate limit after ending and immediately restarting a voice call.

zh: 文字导师以选定学习语言简短开场；对话可切换慢速朗读、显示当前站点语言译文与简短回答。
实时虚拟导师遵循同一语言与回答偏好；导师字幕显示在独立、可上下滚动的对话区，不启用学生实时语音转写。
结束语音后可以立即重连，仍保持单通话、每日 10/30 分钟以及每分钟有限次数的保护；短语音转写升级为 GPT Transcribe。
en: The text tutor opens briefly in the selected learning language and offers slow speech, current-site-language translation, and short-answer controls.
The live avatar tutor follows the same language and answer preferences; tutor captions appear in a separate scrollable transcript without live learner transcription.
An ended voice call can reconnect immediately while one-call-at-a-time, daily 10/30-minute and bounded per-minute protections remain; short recorded speech uses GPT Transcribe.

zh: Max 一对一 AI 导师、实时语音通话、字幕与翻译接口；不改变订阅方案和付款。
en: Max one-to-one AI tutor, live voice calls, captions and translation API; plans and checkout are unchanged.

zh: 沿用现有 Max 导师会话与统一 AI 网关，按学习语言选择开场及朗读语言，限制简短回答长度。
新增仅限已登录有效 Max 的短文本批量译文，导师实时字幕保留最近 30 条并可手动滚动；学生麦克风不做字幕转写。
将实时语音审计窗口从每分钟一次调整为最多六次，同时加入结束即重连的行为回归测试；短语音转写采用新版模型及其 languages[] 参数。
en: Reuse the existing Max tutor session and unified AI gateway, selecting the opening and speech locale from the learning language and bounding short replies.
Add bounded batch translation for signed-in active Max learners and a manually scrollable recent 30-line tutor transcript; do not transcribe learner microphone audio for captions.

Raise the audited live-connection window from one to at most six per minute and add behavior regressions for end-and-reconnect; recorded short speech uses the current transcription model and its languages[] parameter.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、完整本地测试、生产构建、敏感数据扫描与共享站点门禁。
WebKit 全页面布局门禁；发布后在真实 Chrome QA 会话检查开关、字幕布局、语言与重连权限，并核对线上 Project 精确发布记录。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full local tests, production build, sensitive-data scan and shared-site gates.
Complete WebKit layout gate, then real Chrome QA checks for controls, captions, language and reconnect entitlement, followed by exact production Project release verification.

zh: 不会执行付款、长时并发语音负载或更改会员数据；若 QA 账户已用尽当日导师额度，真实语音重连验收须待额度恢复。
en: No payments, prolonged concurrent voice load or membership-data changes; if the QA member's daily tutor allowance is exhausted, live reconnect acceptance must wait for the allowance to reset.

zh: 继续使用 SmartLingo 独立的学习语言、站点语言、Max 日限额与虚拟人画面；译文走现有站点隔离 AI 网关。
en: Keep SmartLingo's independent learning/site languages, Max daily cap and avatar UI; translations use its isolated existing AI gateway.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，回退本次代码发布；没有数据库迁移，原有 Max 会话和订阅仍保留。
rollback.en: Revert this code release if required; there is no database migration and existing Max sessions and subscriptions remain.
